timing_probe.scope: measured on generated training images immediately before the full fit; not used to select thresholds or inspect held-out test performance

yolo.autoanchor_note: Pinned YOLOv5 train.py calls check_anchors unless --noautoanchor is set. It attempts anchor evolution when Best Possible Recall is <= 0.98. Anchor ratio fit is reported for the active generator minimum. Box visibility and localization still require measured validation and held-out results.
autoanchor_training_log_excerpt: [34m[1mAutoAnchor: [0m2.81 anchors/target, 1.000 Best Possible Recall (BPR). Current anchors are a good fit to dataset

snr_definition: 10*log10(total clean signal power / total added noise power over the full I/Q segment)

runtime_seconds_pipeline.note: Measured end-to-end runtime on the configured execution device.

processing_time_per_segment_local_second.note: Measured on this CPU environment; not a prediction for another laptop.
processing_time_per_segment_local_second.measurement_scope: Maximum measured CLI internal wall time across two local CPU synthetic SigMF examples; includes input read, spectrogram, YOLO, extraction/classification, and annotated PNG write; excludes JSON serialization.

shifted_test.distribution: bandwidth uniform [0.02, 0.12]; global SNR uniform [-5, 5] dB

support.low_support_rule: Any per-class or per-SNR cell with fewer than 30 signals is marked low_support.
support.pam_zero_db_bin: [0, 1) dB because the generator draws a continuous SNR; inspect support before interpreting.

cli_examples.scope: Separate synthetic demonstrations; not either held-out evaluation set and not accuracy estimates.
